process.headline: How we sell your home
process.sub: The same four steps every time, and you'll always know which one we're on.
steps: We walk your home together and agree on what's worth fixing and what to leave.
Ana prices it from the last 90 days of real sales, and shows you every one.
Photos, video and a weekend of showings, with a recap text every Sunday night.
Offers, inspection, appraisal and title, handled until you hand over the keys.

It's negotiable and agreed in writing before any work starts. We'll show you exactly what it covers.

faq.q: Do I need to sign anything to see homes?
faq.a: Yes, a short written buyer agreement, as the rules now require. It says what we're paid and who pays it. Talking with us first is free.

faq.q: How do property taxes work in Austin?
faq.a: Texas has no state income tax, so property taxes are higher than many states. We'll estimate them for any home before you make an offer, and explain the homestead exemption.
